# Laws of Hammurabi — questions for the owner

Each entry: date · part · the question · what was decided meanwhile.

Decided meanwhile: Harper kept as base in signs, l and i; the note states the later reading.

HAL is now in the sign glossary. Decided meanwhile: not edited (Run 3 does not touch published parts); for the owner.
